package main

import (
	"context"
	crand "crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	mrand "math/rand"
	"math/rand/v2"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/prince776/go-dst-kit/realworld"
)

var __w = realworld.New(realworld.Options{})

var errBoom = errors.New("boom")

var answer = sync.OnceValue(func() int { return 42 })

// Each line is the same whichever World runs it: the values are random,
// so only their properties are printed.
func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancelCause(context.Background())
	tctx, tcancel := context.WithTimeoutCause(ctx, 0, errBoom)
	defer tcancel()
	ran := make(chan string, 1)
	context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { ran <- "after func ran" })
	cancel(errBoom)
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		fmt.Println("done:", context.Cause(ctx))
	}
	<-tctx.Done()
	fmt.Println("timeout cause:", context.Cause(tctx))
	fmt.Println(<-ran)
	big := uint64(1) << 63
	fmt.Println("unsigned N in range:", rand.N(big+5) < big+5)
	fmt.Println("Uint64N in range:", rand.Uint64N(big+5) < big+5)
	fmt.Println("v1 Intn in range:", mrand.Intn(3) < 3)
	t := time.Tick(time.Millisecond)
	<-t
	fmt.Println("ticked")
	fmt.Println("once value:", answer(), answer())
	fmt.Println("text length:", len(crand.Text()))
}
